sdk_source_refs: SGGK clash/distance/point-relation APIs used by validation
test_goal: Calibrate validation oracles on simple stable bodies before applying them to ABC/source-guided failures.
risk_summary: A weak or wrong oracle can turn source-guided generation into noise; point, face, clash, distance, and exact-extreme checks need known-good baselines.

geometry.parameter_notes: Use simple separated and overlapping sphere cases with analytic expected distance and extrema.

expected_behavior: All oracle records should match expected values; negative variants should fail through validation, not through crashes.
notes: Use this to teach the model what a good report looks like before larger ABC failures.
